purpose: Machine-readable bounded job envelope for dispatching a single unit of controller-initiated work to an external agent worker (ChatGPT or Claude) under the ATL-100 Linear-first cross-agent handoff protocol, per ATL-122.

jobId.description: Globally unique dispatch identity for this exact job attempt. MUST change on every re-dispatch, including retries.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable identity for the underlying unit of work, independent of retry count. A worker or landing operator MUST reject a job whose idempotencyKey has already reached a terminal state, rather than re-executing it.

taskRef.description: Linear issue identifier this job is dispatched under, e.g. ATL-122.

role.description: The exact function the receiving agent is authorized to perform. A BUILDER MUST NOT self-assign INDEPENDENT_REVIEWER on the same idempotencyKey (builder self-QA is always rejected).

assignedAgent.description: The Linear ownership token this job is dispatched to. Must match the agent that actually acts; a job actioned by an agent other than the one named here is a protocol violation and MUST be rejected on ingestion.

branch.description: The exact branch this job may write to. Any write to a different branch/path is out-of-scope and MUST be rejected.

pathAllowlist.description: Exact file path(s) this job may create or modify. No other path may change.

operationAllowlist.description: e.g. ['APPEND_ONE_LINE']. The precise, bounded operation permitted — not general edit authority.

inputRefs.description: Exact source file(s)/commit(s) the job is based on.

inputHashes.description: path -> sha256 (or git blob sha) of every input the job depends on, frozen at dispatch time. A worker acting against an input whose hash has since changed MUST fail closed rather than silently using the drifted input.

verifiableClaim.description: The single, precise, checkable claim the output must satisfy (e.g. exact literal line added, byte-for-byte).

target.description: branch + path where durable commit evidence must appear.

stopConditions.description: Conditions under which ingestion MUST fail closed rather than advance: WORKER_ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE, EVIDENCE_MISSING, HASH_MISMATCH, OUT_OF_SCOPE_MUTATION, SELF_QA_ATTEMPT, DUPLICATE_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ALREADY_TERMINAL.

issuedBy.description: The controller identity issuing this job (the agent/session acting as controller for this dispatch).
